items.headline: Superintelligence Is a Myth, Here's What Actually Changes Everything
items.summary: Superintelligence is a marketing myth. The real AI revolution is the rise of super assistants that handle your bureaucracy, automate daily friction, and change everyday life.

items.headline: Why "Chaos Posting" Is Your Brand's Best Defense Against AI Slop
items.summary: AI has made it easier than ever for brands to create more content. But when everyone can produce polished posts at scale, personality might be the thing that actually stands out.
